treasury.title: Your Treasury
treasury.intro: You gather what the forest gives – herbs, leaves, flowers and other treasures of nature. Not to own more, but to know that one day they may be of use to you or to others. Every badge is a small step towards forest wisdom. Keep gathering and build your own little green treasure chest!

levels.name: Yarrow
levels.body:
**Edible** · Found in the forest

**Season:** May – September (the best time to gather the flowering herb: June – August)

## What can it treat, and how?

* **Works against inflammation** — helps with inflammations of the throat, mouth and gums.
* **Stops bleeding** — for small wounds, cuts and nosebleeds – applied as a compress.
* **Supports digestion** — soothes bloating, stomach aches and loss of appetite.
* **Helps women** — eases menstrual pain and regulates the cycle.
* **Strengthens immunity** — induces sweating and supports the body through colds.

*Unassuming, yet full of power – a forest secret hidden in tiny flowers.*
